      "summary": "Albanese and abelian-variety leg. Three of five children done (.ab, .codim1, .rationalmaps);\n.symmetric and .universal remain, and BOTH are blocked on the same single object.\n\nSTATE AT RUN 0069 r5, measured not estimated:\n * Milne III.6.1 (the Albanese universal property) is PROVED over the symmetric power taken\n   as an interface -- Albanese/AlbaneseFromData.lean, sorry-free, both directions.\n * Milne Lemma 3.3 (pure codim-1 indeterminacy into a group variety) is PROVED, and with it\n   Thm 3.2's rational-map extension is unconditional. CodimOneExtension.lean and\n   RigidityLemma.lean are at ZERO sorries -- any brief or note citing sorries there is\n   quoting docstring prose.\n * ALL SIX remaining sorries in the leg are in Albanese/AlbaneseUP.lean, and every one is\n   stated against SymmetricPower, a sorry-BODIED definition. They are undischargeable as\n   stated, not merely unproved: an equation between morphisms out of a junk term carries no\n   information. albanese_universal_property reports sorryAx and must not be called landed.\n\nTHE ONE MISSING OBJECT is Sym^g C for the proper curve, equivalently the instance\nHasColimit (permDiagram C g) in Over (Spec kbar) -- proved EQUIVALENT to the datum the\nAlbanese theorems consume (SymPowColimit.hasColimit_permDiagram_iff), so the reduction is\nlossless. Over.forget creates colimits, so no over-category bookkeeping is needed: it is a\nstatement about Scheme.\n\nTHE AFFINE HALF IS NOW DONE, with its carrier named and over the base: SymPowTensorAction\n.lean (the S_n-action on the n-fold tensor power of a RING -- mathlib had permutation only as\na linear equiv, so Milne's carrier was not even STATEABLE) and SymPowInvariantsUnder.lean\n(the invariants ARE the limit in Under k, dually a colimit in (Under k)^op).\n\nWHAT REMAINS IS THE GLUING, and it is now three named inputs rather than an unsized\nsubproject. One of the three closed this round: StableAffineCoverGroup.lean proves every\npoint has a G-STABLE affine open neighbourhood for a bare finite group -- the same proof as\nPicard/StableAffineCover.lean, whose Galois binder its body never touches. The other two:\n(i) cocycle/overlap agreement of the affine chart quotients; (ii) OrbitsInAffineOpen for the\ncurve, which is where quasi-projectivity enters and mathlib has no quasi-projectivity\nvocabulary at this pin.\n\nAvailability measured at this pin so nobody re-searches: HasCoproducts Scheme YES,\nHasCoequalizers/HasPushouts Scheme NO, Scheme.GlueData YES.\n\nDELTA, run 0069 r7 (nothing above is retracted; the sorry count is UNCHANGED at six).\nThe affine half of the symmetric-power route closed out. Item 3 of the four-item glue-data\nbill is DONE (Albanese/TensorPowerCofan.lean packages the tensor power as the n-ary coproduct\nin Under k), so the bill is 3 SUPPLIED / 1 OPEN, and the affine carrier is now NAMED at both\nends: SymPowAffineCarrier.tensorPowerOpIsoPiObj (the n-fold product permDiagram is built on IS\nop of the tensor power, actions matched) and SymPowAffineQuotient.colimitPermDiagramIsoFixed\n(the colimit IS op of Milne's (A^{\u2297n})^{S_n}). SymPowColimit \u00a75's bold caveat \"the carrier is\nnot named in Lean\" is discharged and deleted. 12 new declarations, all kernel-checked EXIT=0\nand axiom-clean with controls firing sorryAx.\n\nWHAT THIS DOES NOT DO, stated because \"3 of 4\" invites the wrong inference: item 4 -- the\noverlap/cocycle agreement of the chart quotients and OrbitsInAffineOpen FOR THE CURVE -- is\nthe whole of the geometry, and it is untouched. The affine chain is stated over mkUnder k A in\n(Under k)-op; C is a proper curve in Over (Spec kbar). import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyH1Locus

/-!
# CHART-U(b) — datum-level openness of the chart-membership (witness) locus
(`informal/w4-datb-worksheet.md` §1.6, `informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` §3.3)

The affine-level heart of the shared CHART-U(b) brick, stated directly on a pinned
basic-open cocycle datum in the **witness form** the `chartLocus` predicate uses.

For a datum `D` over an affine base `B`, the locus of primes `q` of `B` at which the
fibre class of `D` at `κ(q)` admits an effective witness divisor with vanishing `H¹`
is Zariski-open in `Spec B`.  This is the single sanctioned openness mechanism of the
campaign (`datumRigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing`, Noetherian-free — dat-d §3.5) read
through the two-way datum dictionary of C1
(`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.subsingleton_h1_tensor_iff_exists_witness`,
`informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` GAP-6): the engine open is the complex-form fibre
condition `Subsingleton (H¹(pair D) ⊗[B] κ(q))`, and the dictionary rewrites it,
pointwise and class-intrinsically, as the effective-witness/h¹-vanishing condition.

Role in the CHART-U(b) chain (the two unlanded links of §5 risk 1):

* **the shifted-datum constructor (link 1):** over the étale carrier `B` the plus
  class collapses to an honest Čech class; twisted by the theta layer and DAT-C's
  GAP-1 inverse datum into the `λθᵐ(Σ-shift)⁻¹` class, then extracted
  (`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq`) to a datum `D`.  The output of
  that link is exactly a `BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π` — the input of the theorem
  below, whose witness set is then the `chartLocus`-over-`B`.
* **the étale-image openness transport (link 2):** the locus over the test base `A`
  is the image, under the (open, surjective) étale carrier map `Spec B → Spec A`, of
  the open locus this theorem produces — carried to `A` by mathlib's
  `IsOpenMap.isQuotientMap`/`IsQuotientMap.isOpen_preimage` once the fibre-field
  invariance identifies the preimage.

The theorem is class-intrinsic (any datum in the class has the same witness set, by
(V1a)), so a change of extracted representative is free.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
/- Statements mix `relCurve C L` with the product spelling `(C ⊗ overSpec k L).left`. -/
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161). -/
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
open TopologicalSpace Opposite

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open AlgebraicJacobian

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

/-- **CHART-U(b), the datum-level witness-locus openness** (`w4-datc` §3.3 step (3)):
for a pinned basic-open cocycle datum `D` over the affine base `B`, the locus of primes
`q` at which the fibre class of `D` at `κ(q)` has an effective witness divisor with
vanishing `H¹` is open in `Spec B`.

This is `datumRigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing` (the single audited openness engine,
Noetherian-free) read in the class/witness form of the `chartLocus` predicate through
the two-way datum dictionary
`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.subsingleton_h1_tensor_iff_exists_witness` (C1, GAP-6):
pointwise the engine's complex-form condition `Subsingleton (H¹(pair D) ⊗[B] κ(q))`
is exactly the existence of such a witness. -/
theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing
    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom) :
    IsOpen {q : PrimeSpectrum B |
      ∃ W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField).left).CurveDivisor,
        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass q.asIdeal.ResidueField W
            = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B q.asIdeal.ResidueField) D.cechPicClass
          ∧ Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
              ((C ⊗ overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField).left.divisorSheaf
                q.asIdeal.ResidueField W) 1)} := by
  have hset : {q : PrimeSpectrum B |
      ∃ W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField).left).CurveDivisor,
        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass q.asIdeal.ResidueField W
            = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B q.asIdeal.ResidueField) D.cechPicClass
          ∧ Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
              ((C ⊗ overSpec k q.asIdeal.ResidueField).left.divisorSheaf
                q.asIdeal.ResidueField W) 1)}
      = {p : PrimeSpectrum B |
          Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField)} := by
    refine Set.ext fun q => ?_
    exact (D.subsingleton_h1_tensor_iff_exists_witness q.asIdeal.ResidueField).symm
  rw [hset]
  exact datumRigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing D hπ

/-! ## The openness transport (CHART-U(b) link 2, topological half)

The engine produces the open witness locus over the étale carrier `Spec B` (or, on the
away pieces, over `Spec (Localization.Away f)`).  CHART-U(b)'s transport (ii)
(`w4-datb` §1.6, "the Kleiman tex 2204-2244 step, now one `IsOpenMap` application")
carries it down to the test base `Spec A` along the étale carrier map, which is open
and surjective.  The pure-topology core of that step is below; the remaining
mathematical content of link 2 is the *fibre-field invariance* that identifies the
preimage of the base locus with the carrier locus (`κ(q)/κ(p)` a separable extension;
`isH1VanishingAt_comap_away_iff` is the landed avatar for the away case). -/

/-- **Openness descends along an open continuous surjection**: if `f` is continuous,
open, and surjective and `f ⁻¹' V` is open, then `V` is open — because
`V = f '' (f ⁻¹' V)` (surjectivity) and `f` carries opens to opens.  This is the
topological core of CHART-U(b)'s transport (ii). -/
theorem isOpen_of_isOpen_preimage_of_isOpenMap_surjective
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] {f : X → Y}
    (hcont : Continuous f) (hopen : IsOpenMap f) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f)
    {V : Set Y} (hV : IsOpen (f ⁻¹' V)) : IsOpen V :=
  ((hopen.isQuotientMap hcont hsurj).isOpen_preimage).mp hV

/-- **The `Spec`-level openness transport of CHART-U(b)** (transport (ii), topological
half): for a ring map `f : R →+* S` whose induced `Spec S → Spec R` is open and
surjective (e.g. an étale carrier map), a locus of `Spec R` whose preimage in `Spec S`
is open is itself open.  The engine's open witness locus lives on the carrier `Spec S`;
this pushes it to the test base `Spec R`. -/
theorem isOpen_of_isOpen_comap_preimage {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (hopen : IsOpenMap (PrimeSpectrum.comap f))
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap f))
    {V : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)} (hV : IsOpen (PrimeSpectrum.comap f ⁻¹' V)) :
    IsOpen V :=
  isOpen_of_isOpen_preimage_of_isOpenMap_surjective
    (PrimeSpectrum.continuous_comap f) hopen hsurj hV

end AlgebraicGeometry

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartShiftedDatum

/-!
# CHART-U(b): the openness of `chartLocus` (dat-b row B-4, the assembly)

`informal/w4-datb-worksheet.md` §1.6 (b-amendment) fixes the openness route of record as a
chain with THREE transports on top of the engine, and reserves `isOpen_chartLocus` as its
keystone.  This file is that assembly, and its central purpose is to make the *shape* of the
assembly checkable now that `chartLocus` exists (`Picard/Pic0ChartLocus.lean`), so that the
remaining obligation is a single named hypothesis rather than a fog.

## What the route of record is, and which links are landed

Reading the (b-amendment) against the tree at HEAD:

| link | statement | status |
|---|---|---|
| (0) class-indexation | `isOpen_cechWitnessLocus` (`Pic0ChartLocusClass:123`) | **landed** (c9a) |
| engine | `datumRigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing` (`GluedSheafEngine:221`) | **landed** |
| dictionary | `subsingleton_h1_tensor_iff_exists_witness` (`H1Locus:182`) | **landed** |
| RE-5 | `exists_fg_isNoetherianRing_baseChange_eq` (`DatumDescent:514`) | **landed** |
| datum openness | `isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing` (`LocusOpen:80`) | **landed** |
| fibre-field | `hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_separable` (`FibreField:157`) | **landed** |
| GAP-1 inverse | `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.invDatum` (`Pic0ChartShiftedDatum`) | **landed** |
| carrier/field translation | `isOpen_setOf_hasWitnessH1Vanishing_testPointField` | **landed** |
| twist collapse | `chartTwist_collapse` (`Pic0ChartTwistCollapse`) | **landed** |
| ~~GAP-1 mul~~ | ~~a datum for a *product*, on a common cover refinement~~ | **NOT NEEDED** |
| honesty over the étale carrier | `PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self` (`Pic0ChartHonest`) | **landed** |
| pointwise presentation | `IsChartDatumPresentation` (below) | **HALF landed** (see note) |
| `cechPicClass_inv` | the class law of `invDatum` | **NOT landed**, and off the path |

(The engine is Noetherian-free; the GAP-1 inverse and the carrier/field translation landed
2026-07-28.)

**The GAP-1 mul row is struck, and this paragraph is a correction of what stood here.**  It
used to say the residue was the shifted-datum presentation and that "producing it needs the
mul/tensor half of GAP-1, which needs a common refinement of two basic-open covers".  That is
false (`Picard/Pic0ChartTwistCollapse.lean`): the twist is ONE `thetaFamily`, since
`sigmaFamily` *is* a `thetaFamily` and `thetaFamily` is multiplicative in its class, so Σ and
`θᵐ` fuse in `CechPic` over the fixed base before any datum is extracted; and
`exists_cechPicClass_eq` presents an arbitrary class, product or not, outright.

**What genuinely remains, stated without under-pricing it** (this is the correction the
reviewer of I-0558 asked for).  Two things, and neither is bookkeeping:

1. ~~**Honesty over a general affine base.**~~  **LANDED** (`Picard/Pic0ChartHonest.lean`).  This
   row read: `exists_datum_cechPicClass_chartTwistClass` takes an honest Čech class `c` over `B`
   as a *hypothesis*, and nothing supplies one, because the splitting theorem
   (`exists_splitting_of_picEt`) needs `[Field K]` — its engine is étale field-cofinality — and
   the only other plus-unit surjectivity is field-only too.  All of that is accurate about the
   tree and none of it matters: **a cover splits over its own carrier.**
   `PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self` gives `PicEtAff.map C E.Carrier (mk C E x) = unit C E.Carrier x`
   over an ARBITRARY affine base, because the map cofinality was being asked to produce is the
   *identity* `E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier`.  This is exactly the (b-amendment)'s "over the étale
   carrier `B := E.Carrier` the class is honest" step, so it was never a general-`A` obligation
   in the first place.
2. **The pointwise presentation itself** — now the ONLY residue.  `IsChartDatumPresentation` asks
   for ONE datum over
   `A` whose fibre predicate matches, at every residue field simultaneously, a split predicate
   whose splitting field `L` varies from point to point (`IsSplitWitness` quantifies `L`
   existentially *per point*).  Calling that "a `cechPicClass` base-change statement, not a
   construction" — as an earlier draft of this header did — prices a construction as
   bookkeeping, which is precisely the mis-pricing the twist-collapse retraction was written
   to correct one level up.

Everything downstream of a presenting datum is landed.

**UPDATE 2026-07-28 (`de63abac6`): the residue of row 2 is now HALF discharged, and the half
that fell was the one this paragraph did not expect.**
`Picard/Pic0ChartPresentationHalf.lean` proves the **forward** direction of
`IsChartDatumPresentation` from a hypothesis containing no witness, no `H¹` and no divisor:
`IsChartDatumPlusFibre`, which says only that the datum presents `μ` at every residue field *as
plus classes*.  The move is to take the splitting extension to be `κ(t)` **itself** — the datum's
witness divisor is already in the right class over `κ(t)` with vanishing `H¹`, so nothing needs
transporting.  That trivial splitting `L := K` had been recorded as unelaborable (memory I-0564);
it is one line since that record's partial retraction (see
`isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness` in `Picard/Pic0ChartTwistSplit.lean`).

What is still owed is the **converse**, and the per-point quantification of `L` this paragraph
warns about is exactly where it bites: one receives a witness over some `L_t` varying with `t`,
lying in `μ`'s class there rather than visibly in `D`'s at `κ(t)`.
`isChartDatumPresentation_of_plusFibre_of_converse` assembles the `↔` from the two halves, so a
lane closing this row faces one obligation instead of two.

## The shape of this file

`IsChartDatumPresentation` names exactly that residue as a hypothesis — a *per-field*
presentation of the twisted fibre class by a datum — and `isOpen_chartLocus_of_presentation`
derives the openness from it over an affine test.  This is the honest factorisation: the
theorem is real mathematics (it is the three transports plus the dictionary), and the
hypothesis is a single, precisely stated obligation.  (An earlier draft said the GAP-1
mul/tensor brick would discharge it; see the struck table row for why that was wrong.)

Writing it the other way round — stating `isOpen_chartLocus` unconditionally with a `sorry`
— would hide the fact that the missing input is a *construction*, not a proof.

**This file is sorry-free as of 2026-07-28.**  Its earlier single `sorry` (the carrier/field
translation) was not a mathematical gap: it was an artifact of taking the `Algebra A` /
`IsScalarTower k A` structures on `κ(t)` as explicit `alg`/`tow` *arguments*, which both made
the statement FALSE for some regradings — `HasWitnessH1Vanishing` reads its `Algebra` instance
inside `relCurveMap C B L`, so a non-canonical `alg` names a different base-change map and a
different set — and forced every consumer to carry two dead parameters.  (No refuting
`A`, `alg` was exhibited, so the honest verdict is "wrong shape, false for some regradings",
not "no proof can exist"; recorded per I-0559.)  With the canonical
instances of `Picard/Pic0ChartTestPoint.lean` the whole translation is
`hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension` across `Spec.residueFieldIso`, and the carrier
identification `↥(overSpec k A).left = PrimeSpectrum A` is definitional.  The general lesson
is recorded on the `chart-u` roadmap node.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.IsChartDatumPresentation` — the residue, named.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartLocus_eq_cechWitnessLocus_of_presentation` — the identification of
  `chartLocus` over an affine test with the landed class-indexed witness locus.  This is
  transports (0) and (iii) discharged.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_chartLocus_of_presentation` — **the keystone, conditionally**:
  `chartLocus` is open over an affine test given the presentation.
-/

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

/-! ## The residue of the chain, named -/

variable (C π) in
/-- **The shifted-datum presentation hypothesis** — the one link of the CHART-U(b) route of
record that is not landed, stated exactly.

Over an affine test `Spec A`, for a class `μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)` (in practice the
twisted family `chartTwist C m Z _ λ` restricted to the test), a presentation is a
`BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over `A` whose fibre witness predicate at every residue field agrees
with the split witness predicate of `μ` at the corresponding point.

Two remarks on the shape, both deliberate:

* it is stated as an **agreement of predicates at every point**, not as a class equality.
  That is weaker than "the datum's class is `μ`", and it is all the openness argument
  consumes — which matters, because the class equality is what needs `cechPicClass_inv` and
  a class-level identification, whereas a lane that can produce the pointwise agreement by any
  other route may use this theorem immediately;
* the split predicate is read at `Over.testPoint`, i.e. at the canonical residue-field point

  ∀ t : (overSpec k A).left,
    D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
      ↔ IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ)

The engine's open set lives in `PrimeSpectrum A` and is indexed by `q.asIdeal.ResidueField`;
`chartLocus` lives in `(overSpec k A).left = Spec A` and is indexed by `Over.testPointField`.

the form the tower needs, namely that the canonical `A`-algebra structure on the scheme

injective on homs, so it suffices to compare after applying `Spec.map` — where the identity is
mathlib's `Spec.map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField`. -/
lemma algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine_factors {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (t : (overSpec k A).left) :
    algebraMap A (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
      = ((Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of A) t).inv).hom.comp
          (algebraMap A (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
  rw [Over.algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine]
  have h : Spec.preimage ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t)
      = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField)
          ≫ (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of A) t).inv := by
    apply Spec.map_injective
    rw [Spec.map_preimage, Spec.map_comp]
    exact (Scheme.Spec.map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField (.of A) t).symm
  rw [h]
  rfl

/-- **The witness predicate at a scheme-residue field agrees with the one at the prime's
residue field, and the resulting locus is open.**

  rw [Set.mem_preimage, mem_chartLocus_iff, mem_chartLocus_iff,
    ← picEtMap_chartTwist]

/-- **CHART-U(b) AT A GENERAL TEST**, i.e. the statement `Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen`'s docstring

`chartLocus_fromSpecAffine_eq_preimage` then turns per-piece openness into openness of
`chartLocus ∩ U`, and the affine opens cover `T.left`. -/
theorem isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal (hinv : IsSplitWitnessIsoInvariant C)
    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T)
    (haff : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
      IsOpen (chartLocus C m Z (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam))) :
    IsOpen (chartLocus C m Z lam) := by
  -- Openness is local: it suffices that every point of the locus has an open neighbourhood
  -- inside it, and each point lies in some affine open of `T.left`.
  rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
  intro t ht
  -- an affine open around `t`
  obtain ⟨U, hUmem⟩ : ∃ U : T.left.affineOpens, t ∈ U.1 := by
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hmem, -⟩ :=
      (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp T.left.isBasis_affineOpens)
        (show t ∈ (⊤ : T.left.Opens) from trivial)
    exact ⟨⟨U, hU⟩, hmem⟩
  -- the piece's locus is open, and its image is `chartLocus ∩ U`
  have hpre := chartLocus_fromSpecAffine_eq_preimage C hinv m Z T U lam
  refine ⟨chartLocus C m Z lam ∩ U.1, Set.inter_subset_left, ?_, ht, hUmem⟩
  -- `chartLocus ∩ U` is the image of the piece's locus under an open immersion with range `U`
  have hoi : IsOpenImmersion (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).left := U.2.isOpenImmersion_fromSpec
  have hrange : Set.range (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).left.base = (U.1 : Set T.left) := by
    change Set.range (U.2.fromSpec).base = _
    exact U.2.range_fromSpec
  have himg : (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).left.base ''
        (chartLocus C m Z (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam))
      = chartLocus C m Z lam ∩ U.1 := by
    rw [hpre, Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range, hrange]
  rw [← himg]
  haveI := hoi

1. **relative representability** — for every test `T` and every `g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ 𝓟`, the

2. **the property clause** — every represented pullback is an open immersion of schemes.

point, hence the represented pullback an open subscheme.  It says nothing about (1), which
is a representability statement about a fibre product.  Read as one clause, a lane waits on
CERT-Σ for both halves.  Read as two, half of the work is stateable and provable *now*, with

category's pullbacks are computed pointwise (`Types.isPullback_iff`).

structure ChartFibrePresented {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)

  W : T.Opens
  /-- The chart point over that locus. -/
  r : (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ X
  /-- The square commutes: `r` names the class `g` restricted to `W`. -/
  sq : yoneda.map r ≫ f = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
  /-- **Coverage on the locus**: an `S`-point of `X` and an `S`-point of `T` carrying the
  same class factor through `W`, compatibly with both projections. -/
  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : S ⟶ X) (w : S ⟶ T),
    f.app (op S) v = g.app (op S) w → ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}), u ≫ r = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w

variable {X T : Scheme.{u}} {f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1}

    IsPullback (yoneda.map D.r) (yoneda.map D.W.ι) f g := by

  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩

    intro v w hvw
    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩

    Σ' (_ : Algebra A L) (_ : IsScalarTower k A L),
      IsScalarTower A (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L := by
  letI : Algebra A L :=
    ((algebraMap (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L).comp
      (algebraMap A (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t))).toAlgebra

    10	# `IsChartDatumPresentation`: the FORWARD half, from a pointwise plus-class identity
    11	
    12	`IsChartDatumPresentation μ D` (`Picard/Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean:161`) is CHART-U(b)'s one
    13	remaining residue: an `↔`, at every point `t` of an affine test, between
    14	
    15	* `D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing κ(t)` — the datum's fibre predicate, and
    16	* `IsSplitWitness C (fibre of μ at κ(t))` — the split predicate `chartLocus` is defined by.
    17	
    18	That file's header prices it as a *construction* rather than bookkeeping, and is right to: the
    19	splitting field `L` in `IsSplitWitness` is quantified **per point**, so no single datum obviously
    20	matches it everywhere.
    21	
    22	**This file discharges the `→` direction from a hypothesis that mentions no witness at all.**
    23	
    24	## What makes the forward direction cheap now
    25	
    26	The datum side hands you a witness divisor `W` over `κ(t)` in the class
    27	`CechPic.map (relCurveMap C A κ(t)) D.cechPicClass`, with vanishing `H¹`.  To build
    28	`IsSplitWitness` you must exhibit a finite separable extension over which the *fibre of `μ`* is
    29	honest, with a witness in its class.  Take the extension to be `κ(t)` itself — the identity
    30	extension, finite and separable — and the witness to be `W`.
    31	
    32	That is exactly `isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness_self`
    33	(`Picard/Pic0ChartTwistSplit.lean`), the trivial splitting `L := K`.  Memory item I-0564 had
    34	recorded that instance as **unelaborable** and singled it out as "worth wanting"; it is a
    35	one-liner once the existentials are staged rather than bundled, and this file is the first
    36	consumer that needed it.
    37	
    38	So the whole forward direction reduces to a statement with **no witness, no `H¹`, no divisor**:
    39	that the datum's fibre class, read as a plus class, *is* the fibre of `μ`.  That is
    40	`IsChartDatumPlusFibre` below — a naturality identity between `PicEtAff.map ∘ picEtAffineEquiv`
    41	and `relPicMk ∘ CechPic.map`, one equation per point.
    42	
    43	## What is NOT here, stated so the file is not over-read
    44	
    45	The `←` direction.  It is the genuinely harder one and it is where the per-point quantification
    46	of `L` bites: from `IsSplitWitness` you receive *some* extension `L_t/κ(t)`, varying with `t`,
    47	and must produce the datum's predicate at `κ(t)` itself — i.e. descend the witness along
    48	`κ(t) → L_t`.  The tree's fibre-field invariance
    49	(`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension`) is an `↔` and so does
    50	carry that descent for a *datum* predicate — but the witness one receives lies in `μ`'s class,
    51	not visibly in `D`'s, so closing it still needs the plus-class identity below **plus** the
    52	transport.  Nothing here claims that half.
    53	
    54	## Main declarations
    55	
    56	* `AlgebraicGeometry.IsChartDatumPlusFibre` — the witness-free hypothesis: the datum presents
    57	  `μ` at every residue field, as plus classes.
    58	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isSplitWitness_of_hasWitnessH1Vanishing` — **the forward half**, pointwise.
    59	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isChartDatumPresentation_of_plusFibre_of_converse` — the `↔` assembled from
    60	  the forward half and the one direction still owed, so that a lane closing CHART-U(b) sees
    61	  exactly what is left.
    62	-/

    90	
    91	variable (C π) in
    92	/-- **The datum presents `μ` at every residue field, as plus classes** — the witness-free
    93	content of `IsChartDatumPresentation`.
    94	
    95	No witness divisor, no `H¹`, no degree: this says only that the plus class obtained by
    96	restricting `μ` to the residue field at `t` is the plus-unit of the datum's fibre class there.
    97	
    98	Isolated as a definition because it is what the forward direction of
    99	`IsChartDatumPresentation` actually consumes, and because it is a statement about the *naturality
   100	of `cechPicClass` under base change to residue fields* — checkable independently of anything
   101	about witnesses. -/
   102	def IsChartDatumPlusFibre {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   103	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)) (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π) : Prop :=
   104	  ∀ t : (overSpec k A).left,
   105	    PicEtAff.map C (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
   106	        (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
   107	          (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ))
   108	      = PicEtAff.unit C (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
   109	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t))
   110	            (Scheme.CechPic.map
   111	              (relCurveMap C A (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t))
   112	              D.cechPicClass))
   113	
   114	/-! ## The forward half -/
   115	
   116	variable (C π) in
   117	/-- **The forward half of `IsChartDatumPresentation`, pointwise.**
   118	
   119	If the datum presents `μ` at `κ(t)` as plus classes (`IsChartDatumPlusFibre`, which mentions no
   120	witness), then the datum's fibre predicate at `κ(t)` implies the split predicate for `μ`'s fibre.
   121	
   122	The proof is the **trivial splitting**: take `L := κ(t)`, the identity extension.  The witness
   123	divisor the datum predicate hands over already lies in the right class and already has vanishing
   124	`H¹`, so nothing has to be transported.  `isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness_self` is the
   125	instance of the introduction rule this needs, and it is the instance memory I-0564 recorded as
   126	unelaborable — see its docstring in `Picard/Pic0ChartTwistSplit.lean` for why staging the
   127	existentials makes it a one-liner.
   128	
   129	Note what this does *not* need: no separability argument, no common refinement, no descent.  All
   130	of that belongs to the converse. -/
   131	theorem isSplitWitness_of_hasWitnessH1Vanishing {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   132	    {μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)} {D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π}
   133	    (hfib : IsChartDatumPlusFibre C π μ D) (t : (overSpec k A).left)
   134	    (h : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)) :
   135	    IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ) := by
   136	  obtain ⟨W, hW, hW1⟩ := h
   137	  exact isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness_self C _ _ (hfib t) W hW hW1
   138	
   139	/-! ## The `↔`, with the owed direction named -/

   141	variable (C π) in
   142	/-- **`IsChartDatumPresentation` assembled** — the forward half proved, the converse named.
   143	
   144	Stated so that a lane closing CHART-U(b) sees exactly one obligation rather than two: given the
   145	witness-free plus-class identity, the `→` direction is free, and what remains is `hconv`.
   146	
   147	`hconv` is the descent direction: from a split witness over *some* extension `L_t/κ(t)` chosen
   148	per point, produce the datum's predicate at `κ(t)` itself.  Its two ingredients both exist —
   149	`hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension` carries a *datum* predicate across a field
   150	extension, and `hfib` identifies the classes — but composing them is not a rewrite, because the
   151	witness received lies in `μ`'s class at `L_t` rather than visibly in `D`'s at `κ(t)`.
   152	
   153	**`hconv` IS DISCHARGED as of 2026-07-29** (`Picard/Pic0ChartPresentationConverse.lean`,
   154	`hasWitnessH1Vanishing_of_isSplitWitness_at`), and the diagnosis above was right about the
   155	obstruction while **naming only two of the three ingredients**.  The step that makes the
   156	received witness *visibly* lie in `D`'s class is not a transport at all: it is
   157	`PicEtAff.unit_injective` (`Picard/CechKernelLemma.lean:361`, Kleiman 2.5(1), the unconditional
   158	close of the ζ3 campaign) followed by `relPicMk_injective_of_subsingleton`, which together force
   159	the presenting class `M` to *equal* `D`'s fibre class at `L_t`.  Then
   160	`hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension` descends it, exactly as predicted.
   161	
   162	What the discharge consumes in place of `hconv` is the same plus-class identity as `hfib` but at
   163	an arbitrary extension of `κ(t)` (`IsChartDatumPlusFibreAt`); at `L := κ(t)` it *is* `hfib` by
   164	`Iff.rfl`.  So use `isChartDatumPresentation_of_plusFibre` rather than supplying `hconv` by
   165	hand — this theorem remains correct and is the general form. -/
   166	theorem isChartDatumPresentation_of_plusFibre_of_converse {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
   167	    [Algebra k A] {μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)} {D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π}
   168	    (hfib : IsChartDatumPlusFibre C π μ D)
   169	    (hconv : ∀ t : (overSpec k A).left,
   170	      IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ) →
   171	        D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)) :
   172	    IsChartDatumPresentation C π μ D :=
   173	  fun t => ⟨isSplitWitness_of_hasWitnessH1Vanishing C π hfib t, hconv t⟩

   332	which `Pic0ChartCoveragePointwise.lean` says is not expected to hold.
   333	
   334	The proof re-applies the criterion at the unrestricted chart, using the `⊤`-datum's own `W` and
   335	composing its `r` with `(⊤).ι`; `exists_factor` transfers because every `v : S ⟶ X` lifts through
   336	`(⊤).ι` by `range_subset_range_top_ι`. -/
   337	theorem isOpenImmersion_presheaf_abelSigmaChart_of_restrictedChartFibre_top
   338	    {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   339	    (rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D)
   340	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   341	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   342	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   343	    (h : RestrictedChartFibre C π n rep m Z hdeg ⊤) :
   344	    IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (abelSigmaChart C π n rep m Z hdeg) := by
   345	  refine isOpenImmersion_presheaf_of_chartFibrePresented _ fun T g => ?_
   346	  refine ⟨(h T g).some.W, (h T g).some.r ≫ (⊤ : D.left.Opens).ι, ?_, ?_⟩
   347	  · rw [yoneda.map_comp, Category.assoc]
   348	    exact (h T g).some.sq
   349	  · intro S v w hvw
   350	    obtain ⟨u, hu1, hu2⟩ := (h T g).some.exists_factor S
   351	      (IsOpenImmersion.lift (⊤ : D.left.Opens).ι v (range_subset_range_top_ι v)) w
   352	      (by rw [restrictChart_app_apply, IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac]; exact hvw)
   353	    refine ⟨u, ?_, hu2⟩
   354	    rw [← Category.assoc, hu1, IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac]
   355	
   356	variable (C π n) in
   357	/-- **At `V = ⊤` the restricted class is EQUIVALENT to `IsChartLocusFibre`** — not merely stronger
   358	than the certificate.
   359	
   360	Backward is `restrictedChartFibre_of_isChartLocusFibre` with its containment `hr` supplied free by
   361	`range_subset_range_top_ι`.  Forward is direct — keep the datum's `W` and postcompose `r` with
   362	`(⊤).ι`, the same two-line transport as
   363	`isOpenImmersion_presheaf_abelSigmaChart_of_restrictedChartFibre_top`; no relative-representability
   364	round trip is needed, and in particular the pullback-vs-open-of-`T` mismatch that
   365	`pointwise_of_chartsCoverLocally` documents does not arise here.
   366	
   367	**What this buys.**  It retires `IsChartLocusFibre` as an independent obligation: it is exactly the
   368	`V = ⊤` instance of the restricted class, so a lane holding either holds the other, and the
   369	`⊤`-refutation `not_restrictedChartFibre_top_of_not_injective` transfers to it verbatim.  The two
   370	classes were being tracked apart.
   371	
   372	**It also supplies a declaration the tree claims already exists and does not.**
   373	`Pic0ChartUnivReduce.lean:55` advertises "`isChartLocusFibre_of_isChartUniv` is the **converse**",
   374	and that name occurs nowhere in either project — the docstring line is its only occurrence.
   375	This theorem is the converse it describes, in the sharp form: not `IsChartUniv V →
   376	IsChartLocusFibre` for arbitrary `V` (which is false in the direction that matters, since
   377	`isChartUniv_bot` is free), but an equivalence at `V = ⊤`. -/
   378	theorem restrictedChartFibre_top_iff {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   379	    (rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D)
   380	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   381	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   382	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ)) :
   383	    RestrictedChartFibre C π n rep m Z hdeg ⊤
   384	      ↔ IsChartLocusFibre C π n rep m Z hdeg := by
   385	  refine ⟨fun h T g => ?_, fun h =>
   386	    restrictedChartFibre_of_isChartLocusFibre rep m Z hdeg ⊤ h
   387	      fun _ _ => range_subset_range_top_ι _⟩
   388	  refine ⟨⟨(h T g).some.W, (h T g).some.r ≫ (⊤ : D.left.Opens).ι, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
   389	  · rw [yoneda.map_comp, Category.assoc]
   390	    exact (h T g).some.sq
   391	  · intro S v w hvw
   392	    obtain ⟨u, hu1, hu2⟩ := (h T g).some.exists_factor S
   393	      (IsOpenImmersion.lift (⊤ : D.left.Opens).ι v (range_subset_range_top_ι v)) w
   394	      (by rw [restrictChart_app_apply, IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac]; exact hvw)
   395	    refine ⟨u, ?_, hu2⟩
   396	    rw [← Category.assoc, hu1, IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac]
   397	
   398	/-- The sharp form of the two ends, as one statement a board row can cite: at `⊤` the restricted
   399	datum is unsatisfiable **as soon as** the Abel chart fails to be injective on some test.
   400	
   401	This is `isEmpty_forall_chartFibrePresented_of_not_injective`'s guard, transported to the
   402	restricted class at `V = ⊤`.  Note it is conditional: the non-injectivity is asserted in three
   403	headers and proved nowhere (the `abel-noninj` fork), so this says "if the headers are right, `⊤`
   404	is dead", not "`⊤` is dead". -/
   405	theorem not_restrictedChartFibre_top_of_not_injective {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   406	    (rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D)
   407	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   408	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   409	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   410	    (T : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ)
   411	    (hT : ¬ Function.Injective ((abelSigmaChart C π n rep m Z hdeg).app T)) :
   412	    ¬ RestrictedChartFibre C π n rep m Z hdeg ⊤ := fun h =>
   413	  hT (injective_of_isOpenImmersion_presheaf
   414	    (isOpenImmersion_presheaf_abelSigmaChart_of_restrictedChartFibre_top
   415	      C π n rep m Z hdeg h) T)
   416	
   417	end
   418	
   419	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartPair
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# C9b: what `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` of a chart map actually asks for
    10	
    11	`Picard/Pic0ChartPair.lean` pins `IsChartUniv` — the `hf` half of the `(f, hf)` pair that
    12	`pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` consumes — and its docstring, together with the `c9b` roadmap
    13	row, prices it as **one** obligation: the relative form of DAT-C GAP-2 plus the classifier,
    14	CERT-Σ-gated.
    15	
    16	**That pricing is wrong, and this file is the correction.**  `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is
    17	`MorphismProperty.relative` at `yoneda` (mathlib `MorphismProperty/Representable.lean`), and
    18	`relative` is *by definition* a conjunction of two independent statements:
    19	
    20	1. **relative representability** — for every test `T` and every `g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ 𝓟`, the
    21	   fibre product of the chart map along `g` is representable *by a scheme*;
    22	2. **the property clause** — every represented pullback is an open immersion of schemes.
    23	
    24	The GAP-2/classifier story is the input to (2) only: it is what makes the fibre a single
    25	point, hence the represented pullback an open subscheme.  It says nothing about (1), which
    26	is a representability statement about a fibre product.  Read as one clause, a lane waits on
    27	CERT-Σ for both halves.  Read as two, half of the work is stateable and provable *now*, with
    28	no divisor-representability endpoint and no certificate anywhere in it.
    29	
    30	## What this file provides, and what it deliberately does not
    31	
    32	Everything here is stated for an **arbitrary** morphism of big-site presheaves
    33	`f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1` and an **arbitrary** open `V ⊆ X`.  No `divRep`
    34	endpoint, no certificate, no `Z`, no `θ` and no chart index appears in any statement.  That
    35	is the point: `IsChartUniv` becomes *this criterion instantiated at* `abelSigmaChart`, and
    36	the divisor-representability shape enters only at the instantiation.
    37	
    38	The criterion's hypotheses are **elementwise** conditions on the presheaf — a fibrewise
    39	injectivity clause and a clause producing the representing open — because that is what
    40	mathlib's `MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists` reduces the goal to once the presheaf
    41	category's pullbacks are computed pointwise (`Types.isPullback_iff`).
    42	
    43	## Main declarations
    44	
    45	* `AlgebraicGeometry.ChartFibrePresented` — the elementwise datum (1) needs: for each test
    46	  point `g` of the target, an open `W` of the test and an identification of the `W`-points
    47	  with the chart points hitting `g`.  This is the *shape* of a fibre-product presentation,
    48	  named so that a producer knows exactly what it owes.
    49	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_presheaf_of_chartFibrePresented` — **the criterion**:
    50	  a `ChartFibrePresented` datum gives `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf f`, discharging BOTH clauses
    51	  at once.  Certificate-free and divRep-free.
    52	* `AlgebraicGeometry.mono_of_isOpenImmersion_presheaf` — the converse direction that makes
    53	  the split honest: `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf f` *implies* `f` is a monomorphism.  So "the
    54	  Abel map is not a monomorphism", which three files cite as the reason the unrestricted
    55	  certificate fails, is a consequence of the criterion rather than an extra obligation — and
    56	  it shows the elementwise injectivity clause below is **necessary**, not an artefact of
    57	  this route.
    58	* `AlgebraicGeometry.injective_of_isOpenImmersion_presheaf` — the same fact in the
    59	  elementwise form a chart-locus argument can actually use.
    60	-/
    61	
    62	set_option autoImplicit false
    63	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    64	
    65	universe u
    66	
    67	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    68	
    69	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    70	
    71	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    72	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    73	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    74	
    75	noncomputable section
    76	
    77	/-! ## The necessary direction: an open immersion of presheaves is a monomorphism
    78	
    79	Stated first, because it is what tells us the criterion below asks for the right thing. -/
    80	
    81	/-- **An open immersion of presheaves out of a representable is a monomorphism.**
    82	
    83	This is mathlib's `presheaf_mono_of_le` at `P := IsOpenImmersion`, whose hypothesis
    84	`IsOpenImmersion ≤ monomorphisms Scheme` is the landed `IsOpenImmersion.le_monomorphisms`.
    85	
    86	Recorded because the whole chart layer rests on the sentence "the Abel map is not a
    87	monomorphism, so `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is false for the unrestricted divisor scheme"
    88	(`Pic0AtlasFromDivRep.lean:54`, repeated in `Pic0ChartPair.lean:14`).  That sentence is a
    89	*derivation*, not an independent input, and this lemma is the derivation. -/
    90	theorem mono_of_isOpenImmersion_presheaf {X : Scheme.{u}}
    91	    {f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1} (hf : IsOpenImmersion.presheaf f) :
    92	    Mono f :=
    93	  MorphismProperty.presheaf_mono_of_le IsOpenImmersion.le_monomorphisms hf
    94	
    95	/-- **The elementwise form of the necessary direction**: if `f` is an open immersion of
    96	presheaves then on every test it is injective on points.
    97	
    98	This is the clause `ChartFibrePresented.fibre_injective` below, read backwards, and it is
    99	why that clause is not an artefact of this particular route: any proof of
   100	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf f` whatsoever yields it.  For the Abel chart it is exactly "the
   101	normalized effective representative is unique", i.e. the relative form of DAT-C GAP-2 — so
   102	GAP-2 is *forced* by the target, not merely sufficient for it. -/
   103	theorem injective_of_isOpenImmersion_presheaf {X : Scheme.{u}}
   104	    {f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1} (hf : IsOpenImmersion.presheaf f)
   105	    (T : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ) :
   106	    Function.Injective (f.app T) :=
   107	  (mono_iff_injective (f.app T)).mp
   108	    ((NatTrans.mono_iff_mono_app f).mp (mono_of_isOpenImmersion_presheaf hf) T)
   109	
   110	/-! ## The sufficient direction: the elementwise datum, and the criterion -/
   111	
   112	variable (C) in
   113	/-- **The fibre of a chart map over one test point, presented by an open of the test.**
   114	
   115	This is the datum mathlib's `relative.of_exists` asks for at a single
   116	`g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ pic0SigmaSheaf C`, written out so a producer can see exactly what it
   117	owes.  Given a chart map `f` out of `X`:
   118	
   119	* `W` is an open subscheme of the test `T` — the locus where the class named by `g` *is* a
   120	  chart value.  For the Abel chart this is `chartLocus`;
   121	* `r` recovers the chart point: over `W`, the divisor family whose class `g` is;
   122	* `sq` says the two ways round agree;
   123	* `exists_factor` is the honest content — a test point of `X` and a test point of `T` with
   124	  the *same* class come from a unique point of `W`.  Existence is coverage-on-the-locus;
   125	  the uniqueness half is *not* a field here, because it is free: `W.ι` is a monomorphism.
   126	
   127	Nothing in this structure mentions a divisor scheme, a certificate, a twist or a chart
   128	index.  It is a statement about a morphism of presheaves and an open of a test. -/
   129	structure ChartFibrePresented {X T : Scheme.{u}}
   130	    (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
   131	    where
   132	  /-- The locus of the test where the class named by `g` is a chart value. -/
   133	  W : T.Opens
   134	  /-- The chart point over that locus. -/
   135	  r : (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ X
   136	  /-- The square commutes: `r` names the class `g` restricted to `W`. -/
   137	  sq : yoneda.map r ≫ f = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
   138	  /-- **Coverage on the locus**: an `S`-point of `X` and an `S`-point of `T` carrying the
   139	  same class factor through `W`, compatibly with both projections. -/
   140	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : S ⟶ X) (w : S ⟶ T),
   141	    f.app (op S) v = g.app (op S) w → ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}), u ≫ r = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w
   142	
   143	namespace ChartFibrePresented
   144	
   145	variable {X T : Scheme.{u}} {f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1}
   146	  {g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1}
   147	
   148	/-- **The datum presents the fibre product**: the square of `ChartFibrePresented` is a
   149	pullback of presheaves.
   150	
   151	Pullbacks in a presheaf category are computed pointwise
   152	(`IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app`), and a pointwise pullback of types is exactly
   153	"commutes + jointly injective + jointly surjective" (`Types.isPullback_iff`).  The first is
   154	`sq`, the third is `exists_factor`, and the second is free from `W.ι` being a
   155	monomorphism — which is where the openness of `W` does its work. -/
   156	theorem isPullback (D : ChartFibrePresented C f g) :
   157	    IsPullback (yoneda.map D.r) (yoneda.map D.W.ι) f g := by
   158	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
   159	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
   160	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   161	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 =>
   162	      φ.app S) D.sq
   163	  · -- joint injectivity: already forced by `W.ι` alone, being a monomorphism
   164	    rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
   165	    have : u₁ ≫ D.W.ι = u₂ ≫ D.W.ι := h₂
   166	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp this
   167	  · -- joint surjectivity: `exists_factor` at the test `S.unop`
   168	    intro v w hvw
   169	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
   170	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩
   171	
   172	end ChartFibrePresented
   173	
   174	/-- **THE CRITERION** — `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` from elementwise data, discharging BOTH
   175	clauses of `MorphismProperty.relative` at once.
   176	
   177	Given, for every test point of the target sheaf, a `ChartFibrePresented` datum, the chart map
   178	is an open immersion of presheaves.  Certificate-free, divRep-free, and with no reference to
   179	divisors: the input is a family of opens of tests together with the coverage statement on
   180	each.
   181	
   182	This is the honest shape of `IsChartUniv`'s obligation.  Reading `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf`
   183	as a single "relative GAP-2" statement conflates:
   184	
   185	* **relative representability** — that the fibre product is a scheme at all.  Supplied here
   186	  by `W`, an open subscheme of the test, and proved by `ChartFibrePresented.isPullback`;
   187	* **the property clause** — that each represented pullback is an open immersion.  Supplied
   188	  here by `W.ι` being an open immersion, which is free.
   189	
   190	What is *not* free, and is the whole mathematical content, is `exists_factor`: a class that
   191	agrees with a chart value must come from the locus.  For the Abel chart that is the relative
   192	form of DAT-C GAP-2 (uniqueness of the normalized effective representative) fed through the
   193	classifier — so the CERT-Σ gate is real, but it gates ONE field of ONE structure rather than
   194	the whole certificate. -/
   195	theorem isOpenImmersion_presheaf_of_chartFibrePresented {X : Scheme.{u}}
   196	    (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
   197	    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1),
   198	      ChartFibrePresented C f g) :
   199	    IsOpenImmersion.presheaf f := by
   200	  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists fun T g => ?_
   201	  exact ⟨(D T g).W, yoneda.map (D T g).r, (D T g).W.ι, (D T g).isPullback,
   202	    inferInstance⟩
   203	
   204	/-! ## The criterion is not vacuous
   205	
   206	A structure whose hard field is an existential can be inhabited for trivial reasons, and a
   207	criterion built on one is then worthless.  This section rules that out **by proof** rather
   208	than by inspection: the datum is unconstructible exactly when it must be. -/
   209	
   210	/-- **Non-vacuity of `ChartFibrePresented`, from the necessary direction.**
   211	
   212	If a chart map fails to be injective on the points of even one test, then no family of
   213	`ChartFibrePresented` data exists for it.  In particular the criterion cannot be satisfied
   214	for the *unrestricted* Abel chart, whose non-injectivity is the linear system `|D|`
   215	(`Pic0AtlasFromDivRep.lean:54`): the criterion's hypothesis is genuinely as strong as the
   216	conclusion, and `exists_factor` is not a clause one can talk one's way past.
   217	
   218	The proof composes the two halves of this file, which is the point of having both. -/
   219	theorem isEmpty_forall_chartFibrePresented_of_not_injective {X : Scheme.{u}}
   220	    (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) (T : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ)
   221	    (hT : ¬ Function.Injective (f.app T)) :
   222	    IsEmpty (∀ (T' : Scheme.{u}) (g : yoneda.obj T' ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1),
   223	        ChartFibrePresented C f g) :=
   224	  ⟨fun D => hT (injective_of_isOpenImmersion_presheaf
   225	    (isOpenImmersion_presheaf_of_chartFibrePresented f D) T)⟩
   226	
   227	/-- The same statement in the form a lane will meet it: the criterion's input **implies**
   228	elementwise injectivity on every test.  So a lane that cannot prove uniqueness of the
   229	normalized effective representative cannot supply the datum either — the CERT-Σ gate is not
   230	an artefact of how `IsChartUniv` was pinned. -/
   231	theorem injective_of_chartFibrePresented {X : Scheme.{u}}
   232	    (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
   233	    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1),
   234	      ChartFibrePresented C f g) (T : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ) :
   235	    Function.Injective (f.app T) :=
   236	  injective_of_isOpenImmersion_presheaf
   237	    (isOpenImmersion_presheaf_of_chartFibrePresented f D) T
   238	
   239	end
   240	
   241	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartUnivReduce
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartAtlasParamFree
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling
     9	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartLocusFibreGuard
    10	
    11	/-!
    12	# The fibre criterion at the RESTRICTED chart, and the `V`-coupling to coverage
    13	
    14	`Picard/Pic0ChartUnivReduce.lean` reduces `IsChartUniv` — antecedent 1 of
    15	`pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` — to `IsChartLocusFibre`.  **That reduction passes through the
    16	unrestricted certificate, which the project's headers assert to be false**, and this file is
    17	the repair.
    18	
    19	## The defect, measured
    20	
    21	`IsChartLocusFibre` (`Pic0ChartUnivReduce.lean:166`) asks for a
    22	`ChartFibrePresented C (abelSigmaChart …) g` at every test — the datum for the *unrestricted*
    23	chart, with `W` a free structure field.  Nothing pins `W := chartLocus`, although the docstring
    24	there says the `W` field "is already discharged — it is `chartLocus`".  So the open `V` never
    25	enters the hypothesis, and one term gives back the unrestricted certificate:
    26	
    27	```
    28	isOpenImmersion_presheaf_of_chartFibrePresented _ fun T g => (h T g).some
    29	  : IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (abelSigmaChart …)
    30	```
    31	
    32	That measurement is **not** repeated here: it is landed as
    33	`isOpenImmersion_presheaf_abelSigmaChart_of_isChartLocusFibre` and
    34	`mono_abelSigmaChart_of_isChartLocusFibre` in `Picard/Pic0ChartLocusFibreGuard.lean`, together
    35	with `not_isChartLocusFibre_of_not_injective` — the criterion's own emptiness guard, finally
    36	instantiated at the Abel chart.  In `isChartUniv_of_isChartLocusFibre` the restriction to `V` is
    37	applied *after* the unrestricted certificate is in hand, so restricting buys nothing on the way
    38	in.
    39	
    40	**The precise status of "false".**  `Pic0AtlasFromDivRep.lean:54`, `Pic0ChartPair.lean:14` and
    41	`Pic0ChartOpenImmersionCriterion.lean:214` all assert that the Abel chart is not injective (the
    42	linear system `|D|`), and by the guard above that assertion makes `IsChartLocusFibre`
    43	unsatisfiable.  But **no declaration proves the non-injectivity**: the guard takes
    44	`¬ Function.Injective` as a hypothesis.  So `IsChartLocusFibre` is *conditionally* unsatisfiable
    45	— dead if the headers are right, and nobody has shown they are.  This file therefore does not
    46	claim the old route is dead; it claims the old route is gated on a proposition the project
    47	believes false and has never checked, which is reason enough not to build on it.
    48	
    49	The criterion itself is **not** at fault: it is stated for an arbitrary morphism of presheaves
    50	and is correct.  What was wrong is the *instantiation* — at `abelSigmaChart` rather than at
    51	`restrictChart (abelSigmaChart …) V`.
    52	
    53	## What this file provides
    54	
    55	* `RestrictedChartFibre` — the same datum demanded at the **restricted** chart, so
    56	  `exists_factor` only has to factor test points *of `V`*.
    57	* `isChartUniv_of_restrictedChartFibre` — it gives `IsChartUniv` at that same `V`, one
    58	  application of the existing criterion, with no unrestricted certificate in between.
    59	* `necessity_of_restrictedChartFibre` — the weakening did not delete the content: the restricted
    60	  datum still forces injectivity of the restricted chart on every test.
    61	* `pic0RepresentableBy_of_restrictedChartFibre` — **the `V`-coupled assembly** (inbox `I-0861`):
    62	  per-index restricted fibre data on the `hf` side, and on the coverage side the containment
    63	  hypothesis `hV` of `Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling.liftPointwiseToOpens`, together give the
    64	  representation.  The two sides are made to share the same `V` by typing.
    65	
    66	## Division of labour with the two sibling files landed the same round
    67	
    68	`Pic0ChartLocusFibreGuard.lean` records why the *old* route must not be used, and
    69	`Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling.lean` supplies the **coverage** half of the `V`-coupling
    70	(`liftPointwiseToOpens`, and the converse `pointwise_of_pointwise_restrictChart` showing `hV` is
    71	exactly the gap).  This file supplies the **`hf`** half — the fibre datum at the restricted
    72	chart — and the assembly that consumes both.  Nothing here re-proves either sibling.
    73	
    74	## The honest limits, stated rather than left for a reviewer
    75	
    76	* **Nothing here produces any input.**  This file replaces a badly-gated route by a
    77	  well-gated one; it discharges no antecedent.  `rep` (divisor representability) is a hypothesis
    78	  throughout, and `IsChartUniv` is not even statable without it.
    79	* **`RestrictedChartFibre` at `V = ⊥` IS inhabited — settled in
    80	  `Picard/Pic0ChartRestrictedFibreSat.lean`, and an earlier draft of this section priced it
    81	  wrongly.**  That draft said the `sq` field needs
    82	  `Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C (Over.mk a₁))` over an empty base, "the triviality of `picEt`
    83	  over the empty scheme: true, a genuinely separate lemma, and absent from the tree", and
    84	  concluded that *no satisfiability witness exists at any `V`*.  **Both the pricing and the
    85	  conclusion were false.**  The error was in the reduction, not the census: the `congr 1` that
    86	  peeled the Σ-component and named `pic0Subgroup` threw away the fact that `pic0SigmaSheaf` is a
    87	  **sheaf**, and a sheaf's value at a scheme covered by the empty sieve is terminal.  So the goal
    88	  is closed by `Sheaf.isTerminalOfBotCover` applied to `Scheme.bot_mem_grothendieckTopology`
    89	  (both mathlib) with no fact about `picEt` at all — `restrictedChartFibre_bot`.  The
    90	  `exists_factor` half is free as `I-0861` measured; `sq` is free for a different and cheaper
    91	  reason than that draft supposed.
    92	* **Consequence, and it is the sharp form:** the class is non-empty, so the repaired route is not
    93	  a route to an uninhabitable hypothesis, and the unmeasured-inhabitation risk that `ChartTyping`
    94	  (`I-0779`) and `IsChartLocusFibre` carried does **not** apply here.  What that inhabitant also
    95	  shows is that `IsChartUniv` at `V = ⊥` is free (`isChartUniv_bot`) — antecedent 1 carries no
    96	  content in isolation — while the coverage clause is *refuted* at that same value
    97	  (`not_coverageContainment_bot`), and at the other end `V = ⊤` the prices are swapped: coverage's
    98	  containment becomes free and this datum returns the unrestricted certificate.  So the obligation
    99	  is the *coupling*, and any `V` that works must be a proper intermediate open.
   100	* **What that does NOT establish, since a draft of this file claimed it did** (`I-1012`): the two
   101	  endpoints are **not** a non-vacuity check for the assembly below.  Two *bad* values of `V` are
   102	  two refutations; non-vacuity of the pair needs a `V` where both clauses hold.  Inhabitation of
   103	  the **pair** is still unmeasured at every `V`, and `necessity_of_restrictedChartFibre` is not
   104	  that check either.  Only `RestrictedChartFibre` *alone* is now known inhabited.
   105	* **The relation to the old form IS measured, and an earlier draft mispriced it.**  That draft
   106	  said the transport `IsChartLocusFibre → RestrictedChartFibre` "needs the preimage `r ⁻¹ V`
   107	  pushed forward along `W.ι`, which is real work and buys nothing".  Both halves were wrong

   111	  form gets `IsChartUniv` *through the certificate three headers call false*, which is this
   112	  file's whole premise.

    11	# CHART-U(b) at a general test, from the plus-class identity alone
    12	
    13	## What this file is
    14	
    15	The endpoint of the CHART-U(b) chain, assembled.  Reading the chain from the bottom up, the
    16	general-test openness `isOpen_chartLocus` rested on:
    17	
    18	| input | supplied by |
    19	|---|---|
    20	| iso-invariance of the split predicate | `isSplitWitnessIsoInvariant_holds` (landed, r5) |
    21	| `haff` — affine-local openness | `ChartLocusAffineLocal`, **named** at r6 |
    22	| `haff` from a per-piece presentation | `chartLocusAffineLocal_of_presentation` (r6) |
    23	| `IsChartDatumPresentation` from `hfib` + `hplus` | `isChartDatumPresentation_of_plusFibre` (r6) |
    24	| **`hplus` from `hfib`** | **`isChartDatumPlusFibreAt_of_isScalarTower` (r7)** |
    25	
    26	Only the last row was missing, and it was missing while being cited by name — see
    27	`Picard/Pic0ChartPlusFibreTower.lean`'s header for that correction.  With it the chain composes,
    28	and this file states the composite so that no consumer has to rebuild it.
    29	
    30	## What the resulting hypothesis is, precisely
    31	
    32	`isOpen_chartLocus_of_plusFibre` below asks, for each affine open `U` of the test, for a
    33	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over `Γ(T.left, U)` satisfying `IsChartDatumPlusFibre` — one equation of
    34	plus classes per point of `U`.  That hypothesis is:
    35	
    36	* **witness-free, `H¹`-free and divisor-free.**  No effective divisor, no vanishing cohomology, no
    37	  degree.  This matters because those three are exactly what the certificate lane produces, and
    38	  their absence is why this leg was always developable ahead of CERT-Σ.
    39	* **certificate-free and divRep-free** — and the instrument matters here, because the obvious one
    40	  gives the wrong answer.  This module's **import closure is not certificate-free**: it reaches
    41	  `DivSchemeCertificate`, `DivSchemeClassify*` and `Pic0AtlasFromDivRep` along
    42	  `Pic0ChartLocusFibreField → DivisorFamilyH1Locus → DivRepClassifyZarKit → …`, purely incidentally
    43	  (the fibre-field file wants an `H¹` locus, which lives in a module that also serves the
    44	  classifier).  So "no certificate module in the imports" is false, and a lane checking
    45	  certificate-freedom by grepping imports would wrongly conclude this leg is gated.
    46	  What is true is the statement about the **theorems**: walking the transitive *constant*
    47	  dependencies of `isOpen_chartLocus_of_plusFibre` (7445 constants) and
    48	  `chartLocusAffineLocal_of_plusFibre` (7448) yields **zero** constants whose name contains
    49	  `Cert`, `DivFamZar`, `FinCover`, `Classify`, `DivRep` or `divRep`.  Availability is cone-relative
    50	  and so is gatedness: measure the declaration's own closure, not the module's imports.
    51	* **not vacuous.**  `IsChartDatumPlusFibre` is a genuine equation between plus classes — `rfl` and
    52	  `simp` both fail on it at arbitrary `μ`, `D` (measured; recorded on
    53	  `isChartDatumPlusFibreAt_self` and re-run for the transport).
    54	* **inhabited.**  `exists_splitting_of_picEt` produces, unconditionally on the curve and at any
    55	  reading field, a presenting class with exactly this shape — so the hypothesis is satisfiable,
    56	  not a reduction to a false premise.  (Both halves of the probe, per the rule this project's
    57	  lanes converged on: run the direction matching which arguments the consumer chooses.)
    58	
    59	## What is still NOT closed, stated so the file is not over-read
    60	
    61	The hypothesis is a *per-affine-piece existence of a datum with the plus-class property*, and
    62	nothing here produces such a datum.  Producing one is a different obligation from anything above:
    63	it is the identification of the datum's fibre class with `μ`'s fibre, i.e. the content the c9b row
    64	calls the presentation, and for the specific `μ` of the Σ-chart it is where the twist bookkeeping
    65	of `w4-datb` §1.2 enters.  So this file closes CHART-U(b) *modulo a producer*, which is strictly
    66	what the chain above it needed, and does not claim the producer.
    67	
    68	In particular this is **not** a claim about `c9b`'s clause (ii).  That clause is the property half
    69	of `IsChartUniv` and remains CERT-Σ/divRep-gated through `IsChartLocusFibre`'s `exists_factor`;
    70	nothing in this file touches it.  What this file removes is clause (i)'s cost — the `W` field, i.e.
    71	the chart-locus open — which the c9b row priced at zero, then correctly re-priced at "B-4 through
    72	`haff`", and which is now genuinely discharged from a witness-free hypothesis.
    73	
    74	## Main declarations
    75	
    76	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartLocusAffineLocal_of_plusFibre` — `haff` from a per-piece
    77	  `IsChartDatumPlusFibre`.
    78	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_chartLocus_of_plusFibre` — **CHART-U(b) at a general test** from that

    80	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartLocusOpensOfPlusFibre` — the open of the test as data, which is the
    81	  shape the `W` field of a chart datum consumes.
    82	-/

   149	theorem isOpen_chartLocus_of_plusFibre

     9	/-!
    10	# The chart locus SUPPLIES GAP-2's binders rather than needing them
    11	
    12	Seven files cite the keystone by name (measured, case-insensitively, at HEAD: `Pic0ChartLocus`,
    13	`Pic0ChartUnivReduce`, `Pic0ChartPair`, `Pic0ChartAbelNonInjective`, `Pic0ChartAbelForkReduce`,
    14	`JacobianDataAbelDegreeWindow`, and `RiemannRoch/EffectiveUniqueness` itself); the chart-layer
    15	ones name the *relative form of DAT-C GAP-2* as the residue of
    16	`ChartFibrePresented.exists_factor` (`Pic0ChartOpenImmersionCriterion.lean:140`; that file is
    17	**outside this one's import closure**, so the name is unresolvable here and is cited by
    18	location rather than bare — `I-1173`), and price its field-level keystone
    19	`Scheme.CurveDivisor.eq_of_picClass_eq_of_h0_one` (`RiemannRoch/EffectiveUniqueness.lean:144`)
    20	as landed-but-unfed: what a lane still owes, they say, are that keystone's three binders
    21	`hD`, `hD'` (effectivity) and `hone` (`h⁰ = 1`).
    22	
    23	**On the chart locus all three are consequences.**  The reason is visible in the definition
    24	and was apparently never read off it: `chartLocus` is *defined* by the very vanishing the rank
    25	anchor consumes.  `IsSplitWitness` (`Pic0ChartLocus.lean:151`) asserts, at a point, the
    26	existence of a finite separable `L/κ(t)`, a presenting Čech class `M`, and a `CurveDivisor W`
    27	in that class with `Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(W))`.  So membership already carries a divisor with
    28	`h¹ = 0`; what it does not carry is that divisor's *degree*, and the degree comes from
    29	outside, from the chart-index constraint.
    30	
    31	## The chain, every link landed before this file
    32	
    33	1. `classDeg_presenting_eq_degAff` (`Pic0ChartCoverageDegreeStep2.lean:85`) reads the
    34	   `L`-degree of the presenting class as the plus-degree of the class it presents;
    35	2. the twist ledger (`chartTwist` unfolded through `degAt_mul`/`degAt_inv`/
    36	   `degAt_thetaFamily_pow`/`degAt_sigmaFamily`) turns that into `m·d₁ − deg_k Z`, which the
    37	   chart-index constraint `hdeg` makes exactly `n`;
    38	3. `chi_relCurve_baseField` transports `χ(𝒪) = 1 − n` to the base-changed curve;
    39	4. the rank anchor `h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one`
    40	   (`RiemannRoch/FLVClass.lean:412`) gives `h⁰ = deg + χ = n + (1 − n) = 1`;
    41	5. `exists_effective_of_h0_pos` (`RiemannRoch/SectionBound.lean:175`) then produces an
    42	   **effective** divisor of the same class, so effectivity is free too;
    43	6. `h0_divisorSheaf_eq_of_picClass_eq` (`RiemannRoch/ClassCohomology.lean:89`) carries the
    44	   `h⁰` value across to it.
    45	
    46	## What this is NOT
    47	
    48	* It is **not** `hb_forces_h0_eq_one` (`Pic0ChartCoverageIndexSlack.lean:180`).  That takes a
    49	  *threshold* hypothesis — every divisor of degree `≥ n` has `H¹ = 0` — which its own file
    50	  proves **false** at `n = g` (a moving degree-`g` family has `h⁰ ≥ 2`).  Nothing here assumes
    51	  a threshold: the vanishing is supplied by the locus at **one** divisor, the one the
    52	  membership witness names.  A statement about one divisor of degree `n` is not a statement
    53	  about all of them, and only the former is true.
    54	* It does **not** discharge `exists_factor`, and therefore closes no antecedent of
    55	  `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts`.  Everything here is **fibrewise**: it lives over a splitting
    56	  field `L/κ(t)` at a single point `t`.  Per the standing caveat of
    57	  `Pic0ChartAbelNonInjective.lean`, uniqueness of the *fibre* witness is not injectivity of
    58	  the chart at a general test — the gap measured as `RelPicSeparatesDivFamZar`
    59	  (`Pic0ChartAbelForkReduce.lean:237`, also outside this file's closure).  What is removed is
    60	  one *named input* of the field-level keystone, not the relativisation.
    61	* `n = genus C` is **not** proved here and is not assumed either: `n` is whatever the chart
    62	  index is legal at, and `hχ : χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n` is a hypothesis.  Per `I-1176`,
    63	  `chi_moduleKSheaf` *converts* that pinning rather than supplying it, so the binder stays
    64	  explicit and its supplier stays named.
    65	
    66	## Main declarations
    67	
    68	* `h0_eq_one_of_subsingleton_of_deg` — the rank anchor at a witness of the pinned degree.
    69	* `exists_splitting_h0_eq_one_of_mem_chartLocus` — **the converse of
    70	  `mem_chartLocus_of_witness_h1`**: from locus membership, a witness with `h⁰ = 1`.
    71	* `eq_of_picClass_eq_of_deg_of_subsingleton` — the keystone with `hone` discharged.
    72	* `exists_effective_picClass_eq_of_h0_eq_one` — effectivity is free once `h⁰ = 1`.
    73	* `existsUnique_effective_of_mem_chartLocus` — **the payoff**: at a locus point the class has
    74	  an effective representative that is the unique one, with all three keystone binders supplied.
    75	-/
